summary.en: Keep footwear storage organised behind a coordinated cabinet front.
summary.zh: 将鞋履收纳整合到统一的柜体正面。

description.en:
A shoe-cabinet design shown with tilt-out storage sections and an adjacent cupboard. Open and closed views help you compare the access arrangement and overall appearance.
Confirm the available depth, internal dimensions, footwear sizes and fixing requirements before selecting a model.
description.zh:
鞋柜配有翻斗式收纳区域及侧边柜门，开合视图便于查看取放方式与整体外观。
选款前请确认可用进深、内部尺寸、鞋码范围及固定安装要求。

en: Tilt-out sections shown in open and closed views.
Confirm internal capacity against the footwear you need to store.
zh: 翻斗区域提供开合效果展示。
按拟收纳的鞋履确认内部容量。
